chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from 'Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari and others, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
If you doubt in the Maghrib prayer, then repeat; and if you doubt in the Fajr prayer, then repeat.

key_terms.الْفَجْرِ: the Fajr prayer, the dawn obligatory salat (prayer)
key_terms.الْمَغْرِبِ: the Maghrib prayer, the sunset obligatory salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: What should one do if doubt occurs in the Maghrib or Fajr prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning doubt in the Maghrib and Fajr prayers. It instructs that when doubt occurs in either of these two prayers, the prayer is to be repeated.
